projects.title: Visual Aid Device
projects.description:
The device is like a pair of glasses that is mounted with a camera to capture the video of surrounding environment and use image processing and AI to detect objects around the user. The video frames from the camera input will be processed by TensorFlow Deep Learning Model and then help us to classify the objects in the frame. Then it will measure the distance based on the size of the objects using Triangle Similarity algorithm and speak the instructions for the user to avoid collision with the objects. 
Link to Elevator Pitch video: https://youtu.be/RQ7rI--CtTI
